posts.title: Art Therapy
posts.description: When I started art therapy, I thought I might do some small watercolours, maybe something with fabric since I sew a lot of my own clothes. I was pretty excited to be in a studio space and have a lot of different material to use. I was apprehensive about the therapy aspect of it.
